name: Alatus
source:
The pieces never made sense – at first.

A painting, a restorer, a hot-blooded Italian, and a slightly insane monk – they were never meant to meet. But they did...

[From [url=https://crueljulz.itch.io/alatus]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这些作品起初毫无意义。

一幅画、一个修复者、一个热血的意大利人和一个有点疯狂的僧侣——他们从来没有相遇过。但他们确实…

[来自[url=https://crueljulz.itch.io/alatus]Itch.io[/url]]
